meta.title: Provider quota
meta.description: A compact quota row above the composer by default, with an optional quota summary and details panel above the sidebar account row. The two locations can be toggled independently. Configure provider visibility, display locations, and CLIProxyAPI management credentials in DSH Settings → Plugins → Provider quota. Supports opencode-go, command-code (also registered as `commandcode`, using the upstream plugin's shared usage service when available), local Codex / Claude Code / Gemini CLI / Antigravity, and CLIProxyAPI auth files that declare quota support.
